text:
Type: checkerboard low-pile area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, children's room
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: short dense cut pile, thin bound edge
Colors: dark charcoal grey, off-white, light grey
Shape: rectangle in a large-square checkerboard, white squares in the top half and light grey below, flat and soft, medium-large, graphic
Feel: bold, graphic, playful
Goes with: white walls, grey or black sofas, chrome or black metal, light wood; modern or contemporary living rooms

product.name: VRBY
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
